_doc: Matas y flores para regar sobre el pasto (Rodin Gen-2.5 Medium, solo texto, quality_override 500). Pivote abajo (center = 0,0,alto/2), sin sockets, muy pocos triangulos: se instancian cientos con HISM (ue_scatter_foliage.py).

parts.name: SM_FOL_GRASS_A
parts.prompt: a small clump of short grass blades growing from a flat round base, bright lime green with warm yellow tips

parts.name: SM_FOL_GRASS_B
parts.prompt: a tall tuft of wild meadow grass with a few thick curved blades, lime and olive green

parts.name: SM_FOL_FLOWERS_A
parts.prompt: a small cluster of tiny yellow and white daisy wildflowers with green leaves on a flat base

parts.name: SM_FOL_FLOWERS_B
parts.prompt: a small cluster of pink and red wildflowers with green stems and leaves on a flat base
